title: Job-housing balance and job burnout among migrant workers: mechanisms and implications for housing support policies
core_idea: Investigate how the spatial job-housing balance of affordable housing influences migrant workers' job burnout by examining underlying mechanisms (e.g., labor intensity, work quality) and using survey and interview data to inform the siting of housing support projects.
tldr: The study examines whether and how the location of affordable housing relative to jobs affects migrant workers' job burnout, exploring mechanisms such as labor intensity and work quality, using national survey data and in-depth interviews to draw implications for housing support siting.
